blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Dinagat Islands Rep. Arlene “Kaka” Bag-ao has voted against the proposed P7.2 trillion 2027 General Appropriations Act (GAA), warning that the national spending plan “abandons ordinary Filipinos in favor of bloated debt servicing and obscure unprogrammed funds while neglecting vital public services and food security.” In a privilege speech during the House plenary session on Monday, Bag-ao said the 2027 proposed budget fails to put regular citizens first. “The national budget mirrors who the government truly values.
